name: nest-graph-inspector-monorepo
description: Nest Graph Inspector monorepo is a collection of packages for the Nest Graph Inspector project

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter nest-graph-inspector run build && pnpm --parallel --filter nest-graph-inspector-demo --filter nest-graph-inspector-site run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter nest-graph-inspector run build && pnpm --filter nest-graph-inspector-demo run build
scripts.verify: pnpm --filter nest-graph-inspector run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
